# Country scope: what every collapse government gets.
wif_sibc_standard_spirits = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_russian_warlord } remove_ideas = wif_russian_warlord }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_russian_warlord_broken } } add_ideas = wif_russian_warlord_broken }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_splinter_no_factions } } add_ideas = wif_splinter_no_factions }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = wif_russian_warlord_economy } } add_ideas = wif_russian_warlord_economy }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = closed_economy } } add_ideas = closed_economy }
	wif_recalculate_battalion_cap = yes
}

# New White Army (NWA) out of FES: 562, 637, 874.
wif_sibc_form_NWA = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_state = { OR = { state = 562 state = 637 state = 874 } is_owned_by = FES } }
		# The army splits in proportion: what share of FES's states go.
		FES = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_n = num_owned_states }
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 562 state = 637 state = 874 } is_owned_by = FES }
			transfer_state_to = NWA
			add_core_of = NWA
			remove_core_of = FES
		}
		NWA = {
			if = { limit = { owns_state = 874 } set_capital = { state = 874 } }
			inherit_technology = FES
			set_research_slots = 3
			set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
			set_popularities = { democratic = 10 communism = 10 fascism = 10 neutrality = 70 }
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Yaroslov Navalnji"
				picture = "GFX_portrait_wif_sibc_NWA"
				expire = "1975.1.1"
				ideology = despotism
				traits = {  }
			}
			set_stability = 0.35
			set_war_support = 0.3
			wif_sibc_standard_spirits = yes
			add_ideas = wif_sibc_white_commanders
		}
		FES = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_sibc_n > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_r = 3 }
				divide_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_r = wif_sibc_n }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_sibc_r min = 0 max = 0.9 }
				transfer_units_fraction = {
					target = NWA
					size = 0
					army_ratio = wif_sibc_r
					navy_ratio = wif_sibc_r
					air_ratio = wif_sibc_r
					stockpile_ratio = wif_sibc_r
					# Commanders stay: transfer_units_fraction takes them along,
					# and once carried off a country leader (see the Zhukov fix).
					keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				country_event = { id = wif_sibc.10 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Global scope, once: FES and CSR collapse into each other (wif_sibc.1).
wif_sibc_east_collapse = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sibc_east_done } }
		set_global_flag = wif_sibc_east_done
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FES country_exists = CSR FES = { has_war_with = CSR } } FES = { white_peace = CSR } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FES } wif_sibc_form_NWA = yes }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FES } wif_sibc_form_SSB = yes }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FES } wif_sibc_form_YKT = yes }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CSR } wif_sibc_form_ANS = yes }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CSR } wif_sibc_form_SMG = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = FES }
			FES = {
				# Most of the old spirits go; the Vozhd's fear stays with him.
				if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_sib_paranoia_1 } set_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_sib_paranoia_2 } set_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_sib_paranoia_3 } set_temp_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 3 } }
				wif_sibc_strip_tree_spirits = yes
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 1 } } add_ideas = wif_sib_paranoia_1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 2 } } add_ideas = wif_sib_paranoia_2 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_sibc_par = 3 } } add_ideas = wif_sib_paranoia_3 }
				wif_sibc_standard_spirits = yes
				add_ideas = wif_sibc_few_farms
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = CSR }
			CSR = {
				wif_sibc_strip_tree_spirits = yes
				wif_sibc_standard_spirits = yes
				wif_sibc_hunger = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Global scope, once: the Marxists collapse (wif_sibc.2, after Absolute Order).
wif_sibc_wsm_collapse = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_sibc_wsm_done } country_exists = WSM }
		set_global_flag = wif_sibc_wsm_done
		wif_sibc_form_CLI = yes
		wif_sibc_form_ICA = yes
		# Tobolsk goes to whoever holds Salekhard, normally the Siberian Anarchy.
		if = {
			limit = { 580 = { is_owned_by = WSM } 579 = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = WSM } } }
			579 = { controller = { save_event_target_as = wif_sibc_salekhard } }
			580 = {
				transfer_state_to = event_target:wif_sibc_salekhard
				add_core_of = event_target:wif_sibc_salekhard
				remove_core_of = WSM
			}
		}
		WSM = {
			wif_sibc_strip_tree_spirits = yes
			wif_sibc_standard_spirits = yes
			wif_sibc_hunger = yes
			add_ideas = wif_sibc_police_state
			# Yagoda is killed. Erling Eigo takes the organs, and the country.
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "Erling Eigo"
				picture = "GFX_portrait_wif_sibc_eigo"
				expire = "1975.1.1"
				ideology = stalinism
				traits = { }
			}
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = wif_sibc.3 } }
		}
	}
}
